title: The First Father's Five Members and Five Attributes
description: The Father of Greatness named in his interior structure (five members of light = the five intellectual faculties) and in his procession (five attributes gushing forth into the aeons: Light, Fragrance, Voice, and two further qualities of glory). Above the fivefold stand twelve Wisdoms, the celestial counterpart of every twelvefold ordering. The Father is the unmeasured source: the five-fold articulation of love-and-wisdom in itself.
